production_rules.style_binding: IAKESI STYLE — BINDING: Use the established Chapter 1 realm distinction. World Observation Area and other Dimension of the Gods material use full-color near-photorealistic illustration: approximately 70 percent photorealistic and 30 percent manga influence, with realistic anatomy, dimensional lighting, skin, hair, fabric, materials, environments, and moderately manga-influenced facial aesthetics. Do not use obvious manga line art, flat cel coloring, or exaggerated anime proportions in DOTG scenes. Observed Zora and Nyas use the established full-color realistic manga treatment with clean black linework, readable silhouettes, expressive manga-influenced faces, controlled cel-like shadows, and materially specific environments. Do not apply Imaginos' 65/35 realistic Western comic style to either realm. Canonical character, culture, language, geography, mana, and WOA assets remain binding.
production_rules.reader_visible_text: Only dialogue, thoughts, captions, narration, and explicitly required diegetic writing are reader-visible. Page titles, scene labels, Action, Direction, Camera, Blocking, asset designations, settings, page asset bindings, and production instructions are never printed.
production_rules.two_file_delivery_binding: Produce exactly two registration-identical PNG files for every rendered page. The first is IAKESI-CH2-###-art.png. The second is IAKESI-CH2-###-lettering.png with a fully transparent RGBA background. Do not generate a flattened composite as a replacement and do not place a folio in either file.
production_rules.file_1_base_artwork: Render complete page artwork only. Include panel art, borders, gutters, characters, environments, props, lighting, effects, and required diegetic environmental writing. Exclude dialogue balloons, thought balloons, tails, captions, narration boxes, story lettering, and folio. Preserve intentional negative space for planned lettering without drawing empty balloon shapes.
production_rules.file_2_lettering_overlay: Use a lossless RGBA PNG on a fully transparent canvas copied from the exact art master. Include only reader-visible speech balloons, thought balloons, tails, captions, narration boxes, dialogue, narration, and non-diegetic sound effects. Exclude panel art, scenery, borders, gutters, and folio.
production_rules.layer_registration: The art and lettering files must have identical dimensions, crop, orientation, and origin. Never independently regenerate, resize, crop, extend, or resample the art while creating the lettering overlay.
production_rules.lettering: Render reader-visible dialogue, thought text, narration, and captions in uppercase professional comic lettering. Preserve wording and punctuation. Keep balloons compact and subordinate to artwork.
production_rules.cultural_continuity: Zoran and Nyssarian physical traits, material culture, writing, technology, and mana practices must follow the referenced canonical assets and the chronology stated by the page.
production_rules.population_segregation: BINDING: Identifiable mortal occupants on a rendered page must be either Nyssarian or Zoran, never both. WOA characters and Goddesses may appear on any page. Distant geography or settlements are exempt only when individual mortal anatomy is not discernible.
production_rules.ear_canon: BINDING: Zorans have normal rounded human ears. Nyssarians have clearly pointed elven ears. Ear morphology is a population-identity constraint and must remain readable whenever ears are visible.
production_rules.development_cadence: Nyassarian and Zoran development occurs in separate narrative blocks and must not be depicted as synchronized or advancing at the same rate unless the script explicitly states it.
production_rules.divine_contact: Zorna may physically appear before Zorans because her emitted mana does not cause them mana poisoning. Nyssara must not physically appear before Nyssarians; direct exposure to her divine mana could injure them. Dreams and visions are the safe channel for Nyssara's guidance.
production_rules.first_law_banner: On Page 28, render the exact reader-visible display lettering THE FIRST LAW OF WORLDS as a prominent banner spanning the page, separate from ordinary captions and dialogue, and place it only on the lettering overlay.
production_rules.dialogue_lettering_size: BINDING at the 1024×1536 master canvas: target 20 px uppercase comic lettering; permitted range 16–24 px. Use 20 px for most dialogue. Use 16–19 px only when necessary to fit longer dialogue cleanly, and use 21–24 px sparingly when emphasis or unusually open composition warrants it. Short dialogue uses a smaller balloon, not enlarged lettering. Balloons must remain compact and subordinate to artwork.
production_rules.speech_balloon_tail_geometry: BINDING: ordinary speech-balloon body and tail must be combined before fill and outline are applied, forming one continuous silhouette with a single uninterrupted exterior contour. Use a seamless curved tail base and unified outline. No separately outlined triangle, internal line across the tail base, visible gap, or overlapping appendage.

layout.description: Six-panel 3×2 grid. Zora left column; Nyas right column. Rows: locate water, dig well, water available.

blocking.description: Zoran water-divination practitioner. Additional Zorans only if required.

camera.description: 50mm medium narrative framing. Show the practitioner, the dry terrain, and enough of the mana effect to make the search understandable.

actions.description: A Zoran water-divination practitioner searches for groundwater. She concentrates with one hand near or against the dry earth while controlled mana extends downward, sensing water beneath the surface.

direction.text: The visual must immediately communicate divination for underground water, not spellcasting against the ground. Keep the mana effect controlled and consistent with established Zoran mana effects.

blocking.description: Nyssarian villagers or specialists only.

camera.description: 50mm medium narrative framing. The evidence they are examining and the selected location must be readable.

actions.description: Nyssarians determine where groundwater is likely to be found by studying the terrain, a dry well, former water levels, and accumulated records. One person indicates the location they have selected.

direction.text: Make the process visibly empirical. Maps, records, measurements, terrain observation, and accumulated knowledge replace the magical divination shown in the opposite panel. Absolutely no mana effects.

blocking.description: Zoran workers only.

camera.description: 28–35mm wide action framing. Make the well excavation unmistakable.

actions.description: Zorans excavate a deep communal well at the location identified by the water-divination practitioner. Workers dig while mana assists with lifting baskets of soil and heavy stones from the excavation.

direction.text: Mana assists physical labor; it does not perform the entire task. Clearly show people digging, bracing the shaft, removing earth, and constructing a functional well.

blocking.description: Nyssarian workers only.

camera.description: 28–35mm wide action framing. Parallel the composition of Scene 3 where practical without making the two cultures' methods identical.

actions.description: Nyssarians excavate a deep communal well at the location they identified. Workers use ropes, buckets, braces, hand tools, and appropriate mechanical methods to remove soil and stone.

direction.text: The image must unmistakably depict well construction rather than mining. Absolutely no mana effects.

blocking.description: Zoran villagers only.

camera.description: 35–50mm community/environmental framing.

actions.description: The completed Zoran well is now in active community use. People draw clean water, fill containers, drink, and carry water back toward their homes.

direction.text: Do not depict the moment groundwater is first struck. Show the successful result: a functioning well and water readily available to the community.

blocking.description: Nyssarian villagers only.

actions.description: The completed Nyssarian well is now in active community use. People draw clean water, fill containers, drink, and carry water back toward their homes.

direction.text: Do not depict the moment groundwater is first struck. Show the successful result. No mana effects.

layout.description: Wide horizontal panels transitioning from mortal-world results back to the World Observation Area.

blocking.description: Zoran villagers only. Normal rounded human ears.

camera.description: 24–35mm wide environmental frame.

actions.description: Wide view of the Zoran community using its completed well. Adults draw and distribute water while children observe and help.

direction.text: This is a quiet confirmation that the Zoran solution works. Keep the scene bright, readable, and hopeful without suggesting that the drought itself has magically disappeared.

blocking.description: Nyssarian villagers only. Clearly pointed/elven ears.

camera.description: 24–35mm wide environmental frame.

actions.description: Wide view of the Nyssarian community using its completed well. Adults draw and distribute water while children observe and help.

direction.text: Parallel the purpose of Scene 1 without copying the composition. Nyssarian technology and culture should remain visually distinct. No mana effects.

blocking.description: Nyssara.

camera.description: Wide horizontal 50mm narrative frame, showing Nyssara and the observation field.

actions.description: Return to the World Observation Area. Nyssara watches the two civilizations through the observation field, visibly relieved.

direction.text: The observation field may show the successful wells, but mortal figures should be too small for population anatomy to become ambiguous. Shift clearly back to the established DOTG visual treatment.

blocking.description: Zorna; Nyssara may remain visible if composition permits.

camera.description: Wide horizontal medium frame. Preserve the established dialogue axis.

actions.description: Zorna remains troubled despite the successful outcome.

direction.text: Keep the emotional contrast with Nyssara clear. Zorna understands that the people succeeded, but she remains focused on the suffering they endured before succeeding.

blocking.description: Terra; Nyssara; Zorna.

camera.description: Wide 35–50mm concluding composition. Terra is prominent, with Nyssara and Zorna included where composition allows and the observation field clearly showing one generation teaching the next.

actions.description: Terra watches the observation field. Within it, parents teach children how the wells work and how their people found the water. The emphasis is now on knowledge being passed forward rather than merely on the wells themselves.

direction.text: Make this the largest and strongest panel on the page. The visual payoff is generational knowledge: the Gods did not simply provide water; the mortals learned how to find and obtain it themselves. Keep the DOTG environment bright and clearly readable. Do not reproduce the overly dark treatment of the older artwork.
